Wellpoint will accept monthly payments made on behalf of applicants/members if the payment is made by the following persons or entities: The Ryan
White HIV/AIDS Program; other federal and state government programs that provide monthly payments and cost-sharing support for specific individuals;
Indian tribes, tribal organizations and urban Indian organizations; or a relative or legal guardian on behalf of an applicant/member.
Unless required by law, Wellpoint does not accept monthly payments from third parties that are not listed above. Examples of third parties from whom
Wellpoint will not accept monthly payments include, but are not limited to, insurance brokers and/or agents, doctors, hospitals, not-for-profit
health plan. Note: As allowed by law, Wellpoint reserves the right to decline monthly payments from third parties.
